tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sngon 'gro'i legs bshad shel dkar phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sngon 'gro'i legs bshad shel dkar phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// shar ri'i dpung pa dag las ma 'gongs shing*// ri bong gzugs kyi mtshan ma mi 'dzin na'ang*// thugs rje'i bsil phreng bgrang yas nyer spro ba// dbyangs can shar gyi thig les bdag skyongs shig /de yang chos don du gnyer ba'i slob ma dag gis dam pa'i chos kyi legs bshad smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba dag 'dod ces bdag gi gan du 'ongs nas/ de dag mdun du bdar te maṇ+ḍal sogs slob ma'i bya ba rnams grub pa'i rjes su slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung bar bya ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las yang dag par 'da' ba'i phyir smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo gsan par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs 'dun yang dag pa'i sgo nas gsan dgos tshul ni/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhag ste// sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal te dri ma las 'das pa// 'gro don mngon zhugs des pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin// gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa 'di ni nyan par gyis// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan par bya ba'i chos kyang*/ rang cag 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ma gtogs pa gzhan du sangs rgyas sogs mchog gsum kyi sgra tsam yang ches dkon pa yin te/ 'phags pa dkon brtsegs sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/ bskal pa 'di nyid 'das 'og tu| |bskal pa drug cu tham pa ni// sangs rgyas sgra grags mi 'gyur na// dga' ba 'di ni ga la 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bskal pa 'ga' zhig tu sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra yang mi 'byung na chos dang dge 'dun dag ci'i phyir 'byung*/ des na rang cag bsod nams kyi rgyu la brten nas/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas 'jig rten tu 'byon zhing dam pa'i chos gsungs|

'phags pa'i dge 'dun grogs dang bcas pa 'di lta bu byung ba'i tshe chos spyod du mi dbang ba'i 'gro ba lnga'i nang du ma skyes par mi'i lus thob pa dang*/ de dag la'ang mi lus rin chen dang*/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus dang*/ mi lus tsam po ba dang gsum las*/ mi lus rin po che ni mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sku yin la/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus ni chos sgrub pa'i rten du rung ba 'di nyid yin zhing*/ mi lus tsam po ba ni yul mtha' 'khob rnams su skyes pa'o// des na rang cag dal ba brgyad 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pa'i lus 'di ni ches rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ ji skad du/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa// lkug pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// ces gsungs te/ mi khom pas chos byed pa'i dbang med par gyur pa yin zhing*/ de rnams las khom zhing chos byed pa'i skal pa dang ldan pas na dal ba zhes bya'o// de yang rang 'byor lnga ni/ ji skad du/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' ma log gnas la dad// ces dang*/ gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs| |bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o// zhes pa ltar mi khom pa brgyad las dal zhing 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i dal 'byor gyi lus 'di lta bu thob kyang myur du chos bgyi ba la 'bad par ma byas na/ 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las gzhan du mi 'gyur te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste// gson pa'i rkyen ni cung zad tsam| |de dag nyid kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen// de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs pas lus can 'di dag thams cad skyes pa'i dus nyid nas 'chi ba'i chos can yin te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ gang gi nub mo kho na nas// dang por mngal du 'jug pa'i mi// de ni sdod med 'gro 'gyur zhing*// song ba las kyang ldog pa med// ces gsungs pa ste/

de ltar na sems can thams cad ma shi bar sdod pa ni gcig kyang srid pa ma yin te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ sa'am 'on te mtho ris na// skyes nas la la ma shi ba// 'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am// thos sam 'on te the tshom za// zhes gsungs shing*/ 'chi bar yang na tshod du gyur pa dang*/ gzhon pa dang*/ bar ma dag nam 'chi ma nges par 'gro ste/ ji skad du/ la la rgas dang la la gzhon// la la dar la bab pa'i mi// rim gyis rab tu 'gro gyur te// 'bras bu smin pa ltung ba bzhin// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar 'chi ba'i tshe dam pa'i chos ma gtogs pa phan pa ni gzhan gang yang med de// ji skad du/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na// bu rnams skyabs su mi 'gyur zhing*// pha yang ma yin gnyen 'dun min// khyod la skyabs su gyur pa med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'chi ba'i tshe gang gis kyang mi stongs par 'chi ba dang*/ shi nas kyang rang bzhin gyis mi 'gro bar tshe 'dir bsags pa'i las dkar nag gi rjes su 'brang dgos te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ dus kyis nyen te rgyal po 'gro gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu de ni gang dang gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// zhes gsungs pas/ des na las de rnams skye ba phyi ma'am/ 'di'am/ dus ring po zhig gam/ gang rung ngu mi smin par yal bar 'dor ba mi srid de/ ji skad du/ lus can gyi ni las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus la bab pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur| |zhes gsungs pa ste/ des na tshe 'dir las mi dge ba spyad pas ni ngan song gsum sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung du skye ba ste/ de yang zhe sdang gi las kyis dmyal bar skye zhing der ni dmyal ba rigs bco brgyad du bshad de/ de yang*/ tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ sems can nyes pa'i las la spyod rnams ni// yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang*// ngu 'bod sdud 'joms mnar med la sogs pa'i// dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu 'khor bar 'gyur// zhes so// grang dmyal brgyad ni/

ji skad du/ chu bur can dang de nyid brdol ba dang*// a chu zer dang kyi hud sgra 'byin dang*// so nyid tham tham pad+ma ltar gas dang*// pad+ma che ltar gas dang ut+pal ltar// ut+pal che ltar gas dang rnam pa brgyad// ces so| |de ltar tsha grang gi dmyal ba bcu drug gi steng du/ nyi tshe ba zhes bya ba pha bong gi dkyil nas 'byung ba'i srog chags lta bu mi'i yul na gnas pa rnams dang*/ nye 'khor ba zhes bya ba zangs rgya ma khal tshad bya ba gnyis kha sbyor gyi nang du 'tshod pa'i tshe tsha bas nyen nas grang bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshe/ khro chu'i chab rom gyi nang du bcug ste/ shin tu grang bas de gnyis res mos su 'khor bar nye 'khor ba ste de ltar dmyal ba bco brgyad do// ser sna'i 'bras bus yi dwags su skye ba ste der ni sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ yi dwags rnams ni 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi bzod pa// bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad nyen 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/ dbye na phyi nang zas skom gyi sgrib pa can sogs dpag tu med do// gti mug gi 'bras bus dud 'gror skye ste de'i sdug bsngal ni/ ji skad du/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod gcod dang*// bcing dang rdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni| |gcig la gcig za shin tu mi zad myong*// zhes gsungs so// 'dod chags kyi 'bras bus mir skye ste de'i sdug bsngal ni/ slob spring las/ shin tu mi bzod dri nga mi gtsang bcer bas 'gags// rab tu dog pa'i mun nag 'thib por 'dug pa yi// mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas// lus yongs bskum la sdug bsngal chen pos mnar dgos so| |zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i sdug bsngal ni rgas pa dang*/

na ba dang*/ shi ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po gsum la longs spyod pa dag go// phrag dog gi 'bras bus lha min du skye ste de'i sdug bsngal ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ lha min gnas na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi// dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che// zhes gsungs te 'thab rtsod la sogs pa sdug bsngal kho nar 'khor bar 'gyur ro// nga rgyal gyi 'bras bus lha'i gnas su brdzus te skye zhing de'i sdug bsngal yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang*// stan la mi dga' me tog phreng nyams dang*// gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni// sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi ba// mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed snga ltas lnga| |lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams dag la 'byung*// zhes gsungs te/ lha rnams kyang de ltar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na ste/ des na nyon mongs pa mi dge ba'i las lam drug gi 'bras bus 'gro ba rigs drug gam lha dang lha min bsdoms pas 'gro ba lnga gang du skyes kyang bde ba'i go skabs med de/ mgon po byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// ces dang*/ rgya cher rol ba las/ skye rga na 'chi nad kyi sdug bsngal dang*// 'chi me rab 'bar 'di ni mgon med pa// srid las 'byung 'gyur rigs drug rtag tu rmongs| |bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can 'khor ba 'di las thar ba'i thabs dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten ni dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di nyid yin te/ shes rab brgya pa las/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na// mtho ris go 'phang rnyed mi dka'// lha dang mi yi them skas la// 'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs te/ de lta na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar te mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i thabs ni gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam 'di nyid yin la/

de yang smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'dus te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ ting 'dzin gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor du| |gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin bla na med// smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bsten pa'i mchog /ces gsungs shing*/ de ltar rim pa gnyis kyi tshul yang thog mar smin byed kyi lam la brten dgos te/ ye shes grub pa las/ gal te rmongs pas dbang gi lam// ma mthong de nyid ston byed pa// sdig pa can gyi lam de yis// bgrod pa nyams pa thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ des na smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo 'di lta bu la slob dpon dang slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa nges par dgos te/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan// yang dag ye shes rgyud shes shing*// he ru ka dpal gsang sngags shes// khro med gtsang zhing brtson pa dang*// sbyong byed ye shes pha rol 'gro// zhes so// slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud las/ snying brtser ldan zhing rab tu dul// dpa' brtan brtul zhugs rab tu che| |gtong phod bla ma la gus pa// zhes pa rnams yang dag par phun sum tshogs pa dag gis dbang bskur bar zhu ba la yang*/ slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i rim pa bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgoms shing bzlas pa kha gso ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms te/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ dbang blang ba dang*/ bum pa bsgrubs shing gtor ma gtong ba sogs gong du dgos pa thams cad ma tshang ba med pa legs par grub nas/ rdo rje slob ma'i ngo skal du dgos pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs sngon song zin pas dbang zhu bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas gsol ba gdab dgos te/ ji skad du/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas te// nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab// ces dang*/ 'dul ba lung las/

gsol ba btab pa gsum dang zhes sogs gsungs pas/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tha mi dad pa che ge mos dbang bskur zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la gsol 'debs gang yin de gsum bya/ slar yang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros dbye bar gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ 'jigs 'gyur 'jigs pa sel mdzad phyir// skyabs med skyob pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// chos dang tshogs mchog dge 'dun la| |rtag par skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi// gang dag de la skyabs song ba// 'jigs pa kun las thar bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ mchog gsum rgyal ba 'khor bcas khyod rang gi mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bzhugs pa la skyabs su 'gro 'dod dang lhag bsam ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la skyabs 'gro gsum dang*/ de nas theg pa mchog la sbyor ba'i sems bskyed dang ldan dgos pa'ang*/ dbu ma la 'jug par/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing*// snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang*// byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu// zhes gsungs pas/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed dgos pa'i tshul kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par bsam pa thag pa nas ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems brtan po bskyed pa'i dam bca' drag po dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la sems bskyed bya/ de nas dbang gi byin 'bebs sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// theg chen dbang gi cho ga la// sngon 'gro'i legs bshad mdor bsdus pa// shel dkar phreng ba ma nyams pa| |gnas lnga smra ba'i dge slong ni/ /chos kyi grags pa zhes bya bas/ /ra stag dbon pos bskul ba'i ngor/ /snyoms las ngang nas bris pa de/
/'di yang gzhan phan don du bsngo// //maṅga laṃ//
